pages.title: Fall Aesthetics
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create autumn outfits inspired by different parts of the world in Fall Aesthetics. Travel with the group and explore styles connected to New York, Tuscany, Japan and Scotland. Mix clothes and accessories to give each destination a look of its own.

pages.title: Drone Wars
pages.creator: Raid games
pages.description: Pilot a combat drone through hostile arenas in Drone Wars. Maneuver around enemy drones while firing back at successive waves, watching where the next threat is approaching. Stay mobile as the attacks build and try to survive the arena.

pages.title: Make Ten Tiles
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Combine numbered tiles into totals of ten in Make Ten Tiles. Look at the values available before choosing a group, and use each cleared space to reach another combination. Work through the layouts by finding additions that finish exactly on the target number.

pages.title: Labubu Adventure
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help a small creature cross a fantasy world in Labubu Adventure. Guide Labubu through each stage and pick up coins along the route. Use the keyboard or on-screen controls to get past obstacles and find your way to the end of every level.

pages.title: Kawaii Claw Merge
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Drop little plush toys together in Kawaii Claw Merge. Two matching toys combine into a larger one, so think about where the next plush will land before releasing it. Keep making room as the collection grows and work toward discovering the biggest toy.

pages.title: Parkour Obby
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Jump, sprint and climb through block-built landscapes in Parkour Obby. Read the distances between ledges before making each jump, and keep control near the edge of tall structures. Work through the courses as the platforming routes become more demanding.

pages.title: Leap and Avoid 2
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide a white ball through caves and laboratories in Leap and Avoid 2. Land on white platforms while staying off black ones, and search in different directions for the exit. Pick up coins to unlock bonuses such as shields and speed boosts.

pages.title: Greedy Snake : Brain Hole Explosion
pages.creator: LAMBDA TECHNOLOGY CO., LIMITED
pages.description: Plan an apple-eating route in Greedy Snake : Brain Hole Explosion. Steer the snake through each puzzle so it can reach the food without trapping itself away from the finish. Study the shape of the level before committing to the next move.

pages.title: Cafe Owner Business Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Restore an abandoned family cafe in Cafe Owner Business Simulator. Clean the space, prepare it for business and make improvements as customers start arriving. Build on each change until your father's old cafe can operate as a growing restaurant.

pages.title: Stealth Master Sneak Cat
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sneak a cat through guarded areas in Stealth Master Sneak Cat. Watch the patrols and surveillance equipment before moving into view, then use openings to get closer to the objective. Keep your approach quiet as you work through the missions.

pages.title: Dragon Hunter
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Pick a hero, roll the dice and begin exploring in Dragon Hunter. Click monsters to help your character fight through each location and work toward the dragons ahead. Keep following the route as tougher opponents block the way.

pages.title: Idle Bank
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Build a financial business in Idle Bank. Open a reception area to bring in customers, collect their deposits and reinvest the proceeds in more facilities. Move the stick-figure manager around the bank to keep its expanding services operating.

pages.title: Idle Airport CEO
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Run an airport in Idle Airport CEO and improve the flow of travelers. Upgrade check-in services, plane capacity and aircraft speed so more passengers can complete their trips. Balance those improvements with revenue and efficiency as the airport develops.

pages.title: Digital Circus Run
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide Pomni through the courses created by Caine in Digital Circus Run. Move past obstacles and keep up with the parkour route as the circus captives search for a way out. Take on harder stages as the running challenges change.

pages.title: Hole and Collect
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Move a black hole beneath objects in Hole and Collect to swallow them before time runs out. Work across the area efficiently and gather everything you need for the round. Spend the money you earn on different holes for later attempts.

pages.title: Design With Me Fall Sweater
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help Elsa, Anna and Ariel make autumn knitwear in Design With Me Fall Sweater. Pick a sweater for each friend, then choose the details that turn it into her own design. Try coordinating the colors and decoration with the rest of her look.

pages.title: Mirror Wizard
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Jump through hazards and use magic to switch sides in Mirror Wizard. Study the mirrored arrangement before teleporting so you arrive somewhere useful. Combine movement, jumping and the side-changing spell to reach each goal in the retro platform puzzles.

pages.title: Saguaro
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Take a cactus for a run in Saguaro while avoiding his balloon friends. Tap to change direction before a collision costs a hat, maraca or another life item. Collect glowing maracas on the road to restore the items you have lost.

pages.title: Spider Boy Run
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Leap between rooftops in Spider Boy Run. Tap to clear obstacles and collect skill cards that unlock different acrobatic jumps. Time your landings so Spider Boy can roll and continue along the next stretch of roof.

pages.title: Bffs Venice Carnival Celebration
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Get a group of friends ready for an Italian festival in Bffs Venice Carnival Celebration. Choose costumes and hairstyles from their wardrobes, then finish each look with a carnival mask. Give every friend an outfit for the Venice celebration.

pages.title: Huggy Rescue Parkour
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search for the key to Kissy Missy's cage in Huggy Rescue Parkour. Run and double-jump past traps to reach the places you need to explore. Collect coins along the way and use the key to free her once you reach the cage.

pages.title: Mahjong Duels
pages.creator: LazyLand SA
pages.description: Race another player to clear matching tiles in Mahjong Duels. Look for available pairs among the traditional symbols and act quickly enough to get ahead of your rival. Challenge friends or enter the arena to face other opponents.

pages.title: Neon Tile Rush
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Slide a glowing tile toward the exit in Neon Tile Rush. Plan a route that picks up every coin and star before you reach the finish. Use the arrow keys to guide the tile through each puzzle's passages.

pages.title: Knives Crash io
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Collect blades and build up your rotating arsenal in Knives Crash io. Use the growing ring of knives to strike opponents and break their equipment, then gather the loose pieces. Watch rival players as you decide which fights your current collection can handle.

pages.title: Shadobirds
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Tap to keep a bird aloft through the dark obstacle courses in Shadobirds. Adjust each flap to fit through the space ahead and watch the shadowy movement around the bird. Get through one demanding stage at a time as you learn the route.

pages.title: Color Wheel
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Match the glowing color in Color Wheel while the wheel keeps turning. Read the next cue and react before the rotation takes the matching section out of position. Try to maintain an unbroken sequence as the timing becomes harder to judge.

pages.title: Mergis
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Choose a lane and release a numbered piece in Mergis. Equal numbers merge vertically, so place each one where it can meet a matching tile below. Use power-ups when helpful and keep arranging the columns to build a higher score.

pages.title: TENX Wooden Number 10X Puzzle Game
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Place numbered blocks so a row or column adds up to ten in TENX Wooden Number 10X Puzzle Game. Compare the totals already on the board before choosing a space. Clear useful lines while leaving room for the shapes and numbers still to come.

pages.title: Twin the Bin
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Catch waste in the correct container in Twin the Bin. Move beneath the falling objects but collect only the material suited to the bin you are carrying. Watch the clock and try to sort as much as possible before the round ends.

pages.title: Ace Brawl Battle 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fight through a virtual combat arena in Ace Brawl Battle 3D. Move around the battlefield and use the available weapons against the other fighters. Look for space to attack without getting caught in the fire as the battle shifts around you.

pages.title: Hexa Puzzle Game
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Arrange the line segments to reproduce the reference shape in Hexa Puzzle Game. Check the help image when you need to see the completed design, then move the blocks to connect the pattern. Keep comparing the edges as you work through harder boards.

pages.title: Lows Adventures
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Guide Low across thirty-two platforming stages in Lows Adventures. Find the three coins in each area, including any hidden along side routes, to unlock the trophy. Avoid the obstacles and collect it to move on to the next adventure.

pages.title: Battle Cars
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pick up equipment along the road in Battle Cars before driving into the arena. Use the gear you collected to fight the other vehicles once the battle starts. Keep moving and eliminate the opposing cars to become the survivor of the match.

pages.title: Pirate Adventure
pages.creator: PulseNova
pages.description: Recover Blackbeard's map pieces in Pirate Adventure by solving arithmetic challenges. Follow the green arrow to find your next task and speak to characters you meet on the island. Collect the missing parts of the map to uncover the hidden treasure.

pages.title: Deep Sea Life Escape
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Help a stranded submarine rise in Deep Sea Life Escape. Tap to call on fish that push the craft in the direction of the trident. Watch the direction before acting and use the fish to guide the submarine out of the depths.

pages.title: Spot the Difference
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Find three changes between two pictures in Spot the Difference. Scan matching areas in both images and click the details that do not agree. Keep an eye on the timer as you look for the final change in each pair.

pages.title: I can Paint
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Set a paint bucket moving in I can Paint and watch the lines it leaves behind. Push it in a new direction to change the drawing as it develops. Experiment with the motion to make sweeping patterns and pictures.

pages.title: Bullet Shooter
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Line up a shot past obstacles in Bullet Shooter. Pick out the hostile targets and send the bullet toward them without losing its route to the victim you need to hit. Work through fifty-one stages with different positions and barriers.

pages.title: Funny Cats and Dogs Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Rebuild eight pet pictures in Funny Cats and Dogs Jigsaw Puzzle. Drag the scattered pieces into the correct locations and choose among three grid sizes. Use fur patterns and background details to work out which edges belong together.

pages.title: Tiny Princess
pages.creator: napcloud
pages.description: Create a pixel-art character in Tiny Princess. Adjust twenty features and choose from bright or pastel colors to shape her appearance. Try different combinations of the chibi-style details until you have the princess you want.

pages.title: Princess Makeup Salon
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Prepare a mermaid for a prince's birthday celebration in Princess Makeup Salon. Begin with a relaxing spa visit, then choose the makeup and clothes for her party look. Coordinate the details before she leaves the palace under the sea.

pages.title: Cool Run 3D
pages.creator: comeplay
pages.description: Run along a three-dimensional course in Cool Run 3D. Shift between lanes, collect coins and jump obstacles as the route continues ahead. Watch for monsters and other interruptions while trying to keep your runner moving through the level.

pages.title: Traffic Jam
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Help a pedestrian get across busy streets in Traffic Jam. Look for a gap in the cars before tapping to move into the next lane. Time the crossing so the person reaches the other side safely.

pages.title: Road Builder Highway Construction Game
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Drive construction machines on a highway job in Road Builder Highway Construction Game. Work through the tasks with the vehicle provided and bring materials where they are needed. Complete each road-building assignment within its time limit.

pages.title: Dr. Driving Mania: Jeep Parking
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Maneuver a Jeep into marked spaces in Dr. Driving Mania: Jeep Parking. Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer and switch the camera when you need another view. Judge clearances around tight turns and obstacles before making the final approach.

pages.title: Girls and Cars Slide 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles to rebuild three pictures in Girls and Cars Slide 3. Look at how the pieces fit the image and move them through the empty space. Try the different modes when you want to change the puzzle's difficulty.

pages.title: Lambs Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Choose a lamb picture and restore it in Lambs Jigsaw. There are twelve images to solve, each available in easy, medium or hard form. Match the piece shapes and picture details until the scattered parts form the complete scene.

pages.title: Hard Flap
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Keep a ball airborne through tight gaps in Hard Flap. Tap to change its height and line it up with the next opening before the obstacle arrives. Stay clear of the barriers as you try to get through the course.

pages.title: Counter Stickman Battle Simulator
pages.creator: Best Games Studios
pages.description: Deploy a tactical team in Counter Stickman Battle Simulator. Choose where your counter-terrorist stick figures stand, then see how the formation handles the enemy force. Adjust the setup between battles to get more effective coverage from the troops and weapons.

pages.title: Killer City
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Collect cash while staying alive in Killer City. Steer around killers and moving vehicles, and look for a baseball bat to defend yourself when an attacker gets close. Keep moving through the streets for as long as you can.

pages.title: Zombie Just Married!
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Spawn zombies among the people in Zombie Just Married! Choose a zombie from the icons and release it into the scene. Watch the infection spread and use further spawns to reach people still outside the outbreak.

pages.title: Falling Puzzles
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Rotate a falling geometric piece in Falling Puzzles so it lines up with the opening below. Hold and drag to turn the shape, checking its outline before it reaches the obstacle. Pass through without catching an edge to continue.

pages.title: F1 Racing
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Take an open-wheel car into tournaments in F1 Racing. Use WASD to steer around the circuits and get familiar with the bends before pushing for a faster lap. Try the available racing modes as you challenge the other drivers.

pages.title: Snakes And Ladders
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Roll the die and move across a hundred-square board in Snakes And Ladders. Land on a ladder to advance or a snake to slide backward. Play against a second player and see whose rolls bring them to the final square first.

pages.title: Grannys Mansion
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Search a dim, unfamiliar house for an escape route in Grannys Mansion. Find clues and useful items while keeping track of the grandmother roaming the rooms. Work out how the things you collect can open the way out before she catches you.

pages.title: Mr Gun
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Line up shots at hostile targets in Mr Gun. Check the obstacles between the weapon and each enemy before firing, and look for angles that let you protect the hostages. Use the weapons you obtain as the shooting setups become more involved.

pages.title: Stickman Fighter: Space War
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Defend a village from space invaders in Stickman Fighter: Space War. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and use the mouse to activate skills during combat. Spend earned money on improved abilities, equipment and weapons for the next waves.

pages.title: Cartoon Animals In Cars Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Match three or more identical blocks in Cartoon Animals In Cars Match 3. Keep the meter on the left from dropping too low by finding a steady sequence of moves. Watch the board after each match for a useful new group.

pages.title: Maths Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Answer timed arithmetic questions in Maths Challenge. Work out each result and choose it before the countdown ends, then move on to the next problem. See how many calculations you can get right as you play through the test.

pages.title: PK Cargo Truck Driving Game 2019
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Haul goods over long routes in PK Cargo Truck Driving Game 2019. Keep the truck under control as you follow roads through the Pakistani setting. Watch the terrain ahead and adjust your driving to get the load to its destination.

pages.title: Happy Halloween Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together Halloween pictures in Happy Halloween Puzzle. Pick one of six images and choose a 16-, 36-, 64- or 100-piece layout. Look at the outlines and colors to join the pieces and rebuild each spooky scene.

pages.title: Wrecked
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Keep driving around a circular arena in Wrecked while avoiding the other cars. Pick up money as you find room to maneuver and collect ice or dynamite to deal with pursuers. Stay clear of collisions to prolong the run.

pages.title: Sisters day celebration
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dress Emma and Mia for their special day in Sisters day celebration. Browse their clothes and choose outfits for both sisters, adding details that suit the occasion. Try different combinations before finishing their looks for the celebration.

pages.title: Gems Merge
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Bring equal numbered jewels together in Gems Merge. Each pair becomes a gem with a higher value, changing the combinations you can make next. Leave useful space around your growing gems so you can keep merging them.

pages.title: Train Fascinate Travels
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Operate a train through successive routes in Train Fascinate Travels. Use W and S or the arrow keys to control its movement, getting used to acceleration and braking. Complete the driving tasks as you work through the simulator's levels.

pages.title: Scary Granny House
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Explore a sinister building in Scary Granny House and look for the next door that can lead to safety. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and interact with objects using E. Keep searching while watching for the woman hunting inside.

pages.title: Race Monster Truck
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Drive monster trucks off-road in Race Monster Truck. Practice handling the vehicles, enter career challenges or try survival mode for a different race. Use the cash from completed events to unlock the truck you want to take out next.

pages.title: Cowboy
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Swing a lasso at fleeing animals in Cowboy. Watch the animal you want to catch and release the rope when it is lined up. Bring more animals home as you get used to judging the timing and range.

pages.title: Cool Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore six vehicle pictures in Cool Cars Puzzle. Choose how many pieces you want to work with, from sixteen for a short puzzle to one hundred for more detail. Fit the bodywork and background sections together to complete the car image.

pages.title: Run Race 3D 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Run a parkour race in Run Race 3D 2. Jump between walls, climb ropes and swing from bars as you follow the course toward the finish. Use the mouse or space bar to time jumps and keep pace with the other racers.

pages.title: Slam Dunk Forever
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Release a basketball from its swinging rope in Slam Dunk Forever. Pick the moment that sends it into the hoop and try to extend your scoring streak. Adjust for bouncers and other obstacles, with bonuses available for accurate or quick shots.

pages.title: EG Little Strawberry
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Time a strawberry's leaps over bars in EG Little Strawberry. Watch the jump indicator at the top of the screen as you use the available jumps to clear each barrier. A missed obstacle ends the run, so make every leap count.

pages.title: Ninja Run
pages.creator: Game-Game.com.ua
pages.description: Run and jump through a course of obstacles in Ninja Run. Collect coins whenever the path is clear and time your leaps to avoid bombs and gaps. Keep checking the next landing so you can continue farther along the route.

pages.title: Witch to Princess: Beauty Potion Game
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Help a witch transform herself in Witch to Princess: Beauty Potion Game. Work in the castle dungeon to create the potion she needs, then follow the makeover as her royal look takes shape. Use the available choices to prepare her for meeting a prince.

pages.title: Exotic Sea Animals
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild underwater pictures in Exotic Sea Animals. Select a sea-creature image and choose easy, medium or hard difficulty before arranging the pieces. With no timer to watch, you can use the shapes and details to solve each picture at your own pace.

pages.title: Ice Skating Winter
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose skating clothes for two princesses in Ice Skating Winter. Try outfits suited to a day on the rink and coordinate the pieces for each friend. Finish their winter looks before joining them for the outing.

pages.title: Aqua Pipes
pages.creator: QiGames Studio
pages.description: Connect pipe sections to direct clean water into the blue outlets in Aqua Pipes. Inspect the branching layout before changing a section and follow the route from the supply to its destination. Get the channels connected so the water can reach the required pipes.

pages.title: Olaf Jumper
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Charge a leap and release Olaf across small platforms in Olaf Jumper. Travel through icy terrain and volcanic stretches, adjusting the jump power for each gap. The more platforms you successfully pass, the higher your score grows.

pages.title: Airport Control
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Direct aircraft toward landing in Airport Control. Select planes before they leave the screen and complete the traffic-control tasks to score points. Keep their paths clear of one another so the busy airport avoids a collision.

pages.title: Cute Bear Caring
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Look after a young bear in Cute Bear Caring. Start by choosing the playground activities it asks for, then give it a bath once playtime is done. Finish by helping the bear find a style of its own.

pages.title: Rescue Space
pages.creator: kiko vidal
pages.description: Pilot through space to pick up stranded astronauts in Rescue Space. Watch for asteroids and satellites as you choose a route toward each person. Make room to avoid hazards while bringing the lost travelers to safety.

pages.title: Wilds.io
pages.creator: Rezoner
pages.description: Fight other players in Wilds.io using close-range attacks and role-playing progression. Collect gold from defeated enemies and spend it on new equipment. Join a guild and enter arena fights to work toward a stronger reputation.

pages.title: Desert Roll
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Keep a duck balanced on a rolling ball in Desert Roll. Guide it along the route and collect coins without letting the duck lose its footing. Pay attention to the terrain and adjust your movement as the ball carries it forward.

pages.title: Operate Now Hospital Surgeon
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Treat five patients in Operate Now Hospital Surgeon. Work with the nurse in the operating room and follow the procedure for each case. Choose tools as prompted and complete the simulated operations before moving on to the next patient.

pages.title: Mole: The First Scavange
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Find a short route to vegetables in Mole: The First Scavange. Look through the underground layout before guiding the hungry mole onward. Choose the path that reaches its food with as little unnecessary travel as possible.

pages.title: Super Mega Solitaire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Sort cards and reveal hidden ones in Super Mega Solitaire. Look for moves that open space on the table, then build the piles needed to clear the deal. Keep checking the cards exposed by each move for another play.

pages.title: Dove Christmas Surprises
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Open gift boxes to build a holiday look in Dove Christmas Surprises. Mix the clothes and accessories you uncover, look for special surprises and unlock more of the collection. Save a picture from the gallery when you have an outfit you want to keep.
